rule: FL-M5 T10 router: pre-registered before serve/router.py exists or any route is solved

inputs.split: dev only; the test split is not used by the router

traffic_per_day.basis: stated demo scenario sized to the 500 RPD free tier, not a measurement

infeasible_case.why: long synthesis is Gemini-only; 600/day exceeds 500 RPD

traffic_per_day.arrival: spread evenly over 24 h (for the per-minute RPM and TPM checks)

S2_gpu_off.why: the laptop GPU isn't serving; CPU GGUF and the hosted API remain

eligibility.context: a backend takes long_synthesis only if context_tokens >= 16384 (router_inputs)
eligibility.latency_basis: short Q&A is interactive (a user waits); extraction is a batch job; long synthesis latency is not measured, so no limit
eligibility.why_not_linear: p95 of a traffic mix is not the share-weighted mean of p95s, so latency filters backends per class instead of entering the LP

accuracy_floor.rule: per (scenario, class): highest dev accuracy among that class's eligible backends in the scenario, minus 0.01
accuracy_floor.lp_form: sum over backends of share x accuracy >= floor (expected accuracy is linear in the shares)
accuracy_floor.sweep: the notebook also reports LP and greedy cost over floors from the lowest to the highest eligible accuracy in steps of 0.0025, per class and scenario

capacity.gemini_rpd: sum over classes of share x traffic <= 500
capacity.gemini_rpm: sum over classes of share x traffic / 1440 <= 15
capacity.gemini_tpm: sum over classes of share x traffic / 1440 x prompt tokens <= 250000 (long synthesis at its nominal 15,984-token prompt)
capacity.local_busy_seconds: per local backend: sum over classes of share x traffic x mean latency (c=1) <= 86400
capacity.error_rate: recorded in router_inputs, not a constraint

objective: minimize sum of share x traffic x usd_per_request (list prices; actual spend is $0)
solver: scipy.optimize.linprog, method='highs'; shares in [0, 1]; each class's shares sum to 1

greedy_baseline.author: hand-written by the user (greedy_route)
greedy_baseline.rule: classes in the order extraction, short_qa, long_synthesis; for each, the eligible backends whose own accuracy meets the floor, cheapest first; give each as much of the class's traffic as its remaining capacity allows, then the next; traffic left over is unrouted (greedy infeasible for that class). Greedy never blends a below-floor backend in.
greedy_baseline.capacity_order: greedy uses the same capacity limits as the LP, consumed in class order

report.per_scenario: status, cost per day (LP, greedy), savings = greedy - LP in $ and %, shares, binding constraints (slack 0) and their duals
report.infeasible: LP status for the infeasible case, and which constraint makes it infeasible
report.if_greedy_unrouted: savings are not defined; report that greedy leaves N requests unrouted while the LP routes all (or that both fail)
report.if_equal: if LP and greedy cost the same, report $0 savings as found

checks.brute_force: on 200 random small cases (2-3 backends, 2 classes, random accuracies, costs, capacities), the LP's cost <= the best grid search (shares in steps of 0.05) + 1e-9, and the LP solution satisfies every constraint within 1e-9
checks.greedy_review: the user's greedy_route is checked against the same constraints: never above capacity, never below floor, unrouted counted
